triage.note: BURNED HELD-OUT CASE, PROMOTED AND ENUMERATED AS DEBT. Goldman Sachs FY2002 (period end 2002-11-29, filed 2003-02-27) adopted the post-Sarbanes-Oxley numbering EARLY: its body carries 'Item 14. Controls and Procedures' and 'Item 15. Exhibits, Financial Statement Schedules, and Reports on Form 8-K' as real headings, each with a matching contents-page row. segment.ADDED encodes Item 15 as arriving 2003-08-14, so expected_items never expects it, find_candidates never makes it a candidate, and it cannot even reach the TOC manifest to raise a mismatch — the item is absent from the envelope with nothing anywhere registering the loss. The item_present('15') assertion below is therefore RED and is expected to stay red until the era model is reworked. THE FIX IS DELIBERATELY NOT TAKEN AT B: letting a physically present heading for a known code surface regardless of era expectation conflicts with INV-S3 as written ('era-invalid and non-canonical codes never surface'), so it is a spec change plus an invariant amendment, not a bug fix — A-level scope per ADR-013. This is the THIRD independent confirmation of the debt ADR-010 recorded: the era table is a single point of silent failure, and any item mis-dated by one season repeats this exactly (Item 9C was the first, in the opposite direction).

provenance: BURNED 2026-08-17, promoted from evals/heldout/. Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. FY2002 10-K, EDGAR accession 0000950123-03-002099, filed 2003-02-27, primary document y83718e10vk.htm (395,754 bytes); the fixture moved from evals/heldout/fixtures/ to evals/fixtures/ unchanged (git mv, byte-identical). WHY IT IS BURNED: it was run twice (H1 20260816-225101, H1b 20260816-231253), its failure mode is published in four documents, and ADR-013's decision NOT to fix the era model was taken with its outcome in hand. The repo's burn rule names 'a threshold choice' as burning, and a documented decision to decline a fix is at least as much influence as a threshold — so it can no longer serve as a generalization estimate and counting it in a held-out denominator would overstate that denominator. Its original held-out provenance, including the prediction recorded BEFORE the first run, is in git history at 5a17149. WHAT THE CASE ASSERTS: the passing checks pin the behaviour that IS correct on this filing — item 1 extracted, item 7A incorporated_by_reference (a genuine whole-item pointer whose body ends 'is incorporated herein by reference'; asserting it 'extracted' was one of the four authoring errors H1 caught), no Item 1A in the 2002 taxonomy, and the era-valid 15-code expected set complete. The failing check is item_present('15'), asserted on the authority of the DOCUMENT rather than of the era table. only_items allows the era-valid 15 codes plus 15, so the two checks fail for distinguishable reasons. Tagged 'debt': the runner executes it every run and prints its state, but excludes it from the score — scoring it would force a choice between breaking the gate and rewriting the case to assert the bug as correct, which is precisely the mistake sandston-2021-shallow made with Item 9C and which H1 caught. If it ever goes green the runner says 'NOW GREEN — promote it'.
